source: SCORING PLAN A10.1 §3.5 (A10.1 B1): the minimum re-qualification before dispatch when a category digest differs. Data, not code: equivalence_record.decide() selects rows by the differing parts and reads action, text and flags from here.

rows.meaning: a result-bearing module changed between trial and main (merge resolution, CI repair), and only modules outside the solver, the checker and the evaluator
rows.text: Re-run the 4-class slice and the amd64 run (TR1) before dispatch.

rows.meaning: a solver, checker or evaluator module changed, or the module lists, the import closure, the required modules or the qualification CHECK function differ
selection, registry, ruling, convention or orb policy differ

rows.text: Full TR before dispatch; stop and tell the surrogate if L0 changed after the freeze.

rows.meaning: an L1 or dasha input differs
the century snapshot lacks a trial-consumed row, or has it with different content, or the coverage evidence is not available
rows.text: Block dispatch, repair the snapshot, re-run EQ_CHECK.
Full TR before dispatch (a different numeric series).

rows.meaning: a different ephemeris file, library, architecture, Python or dependency lock with an identical probe
rows.text: Re-run the amd64 slice on the dispatch image.
Correct the config; full TR because budgets or tolerances changed.

rows.meaning: horizon, basis, policy, deferral, class universe or verification plan differ
rows.text: Correct the config, then re-run EQ_CHECK.

rows.meaning: labels only (commit, tree, image, run ids, timestamps)
rows.text: None — the decision stays EQUAL; the century is dispatched on the trial evidence.

rows.meaning: (I) a category is null on either side (a source could not be read, N.7.6): equality is not established
rows.text: Supply the missing pinned input or module constant named in the record, rebuild the record, re-run EQ_CHECK.
